units.source_text: 不知到了何生何世，此恨才得稍慰呢！”

en.t: Who knows in what life or what age this grief will finally be eased even a little!"

units.source_text: 他的悲哀无有尽期，无心返京，只管茫茫然地耽于沉思。

en.t: His sorrow had no end; he had no heart to return to the capital, and simply sank into a blank, desolate reverie.

units.source_text: 此时日色已暮，但倘肆意在此泊宿，深恐匂亲王见怪，却甚没趣，便动身返京。

en.t: By then the day had already darkened, but if he stayed there overnight as he pleased, he feared Prince Niou would find it strange, which would be terribly awkward, so he set out for the capital.
